prompt:
HERO TYPOGRAPHY RULE

Apply this typography structure to every hero headline.

Headline must be split into 2 parts:

1. Subject or first half of the sentence
- Font: Roboto Bold
- Case: Title Case
- Style: Strong, clean, premium
- Place on the first line only

2. Predicate or second half of the sentence
- Font: Roboto Italic
- Case: Title Case
- Style: Lighter, elegant, editorial
- Place on a separate second line

Rules:
- Never place both parts on the same line
- The first line should feel like the anchor
- The second line should feel like the soft continuation
- Maintain clear visual hierarchy between the two lines
- Keep spacing tight and intentional
- Ensure the two-line headline reads naturally and poetically
- Do not rewrite the copy unless explicitly instructed
- Preserve the exact wording and only apply formatting

Example structure:

Strength Begins In Motion.
Momentum Becomes Meaningful.

Design intent:
- Premium
- Editorial
- Calm
- High readability
- Apple / Lululemon inspired
